version: Bundled immutable bytes of retrospective 2024 window; producer can revise old records.

period_label: Inspecciones de enero–diciembre 2024; snapshot adquirido en noviembre 2026
selection: All received 2024 inspection/intervention rows for six selected fields; stable ordered query; limit500000; independent count234596 proves no limit truncation.

metadata_receipt.scope: Hash of normalized JSON metadata, not original HTTP response bytes; used to review schema and producer limitations.

documentation_receipts.scope: Complete official manual fetched, section2.3.2 read; website imagery not republished.

limitations: Inspections are complaint-driven/proactive surveillance, not random sampling or a census of animals.
No neighborhood geometry, costs, temperatures, uninspected property denominator or total rat population.
A one-year retrospective window can be revised by the producer; no recurring seasonality or causal heat effect.
